lead.title: CorWave's wave-membrane heart pump clears its first five patients as the company lands up to €51.9M in EU funding
lead.deck: Presented at the EACTS MCS summit in Amsterdam (Nov 19-21) and announced on Nov 26, the feasibility study of CorWave's left ventricular assist system (LVAS) met its primary endpoint: all five advanced heart failure patients, implanted at St Vincent's Hospital in Sydney and the UMC Heart Center in Astana, were alive and free of device-related adverse events at 30 days, with more than 650 cumulative days of support and no pump failure or thrombosis. Instead of a rotary impeller, a polymer membrane undulates in step with the heartbeat to mimic the heart's natural pumping; the Clichy-based company (over €100M raised from Sofinnova, Novo Holdings, Ysios, the EIC Fund and Bpifrance) is also receiving up to €51.9M through IPCEI Tech4Cure — the programme's largest award — and is preparing the pivotal trial meant to support its CE mark.

milestone.title: Neuralink gets FDA go-ahead for LINK, the first US pivotal trial of an implantable brain-computer interface
milestone.summary: Announced on Nov 25, the approval launches the LINK study in US adults with severe paralysis from ALS: it must show they can control computers and phones by thought in daily life, with about 24 months of follow-up and long-term safety monitoring across several sites. More than 30 people already carry the implant in feasibility studies in the US, Canada and the UK.
milestone.why: A pivotal trial is the last step before a marketing application: implantable neurotech is moving out of the experimental phase and into regulatory-dossier mode. It sets a timeline and evidence benchmark for the whole field, including European neural-implant players, which investors will now measure against it.

deal.thesis: The European Investment Bank is lending €25M in venture debt, under InvestEU, to the Eindhoven medtech that closed a $60M Series B in 2025: non-dilutive debt backed by an advanced clinical asset, funding European and US trials (including RECLAIM-II, now under way in the US) of its ultra-thin implant for treatment-resistant migraine. A sign that peripheral neuromodulation, still pre-commercial, is seen as de-risked enough to be financed with European public debt.

brefsEurope.title: SPCTR raises €2.8M to tell surgeons, in the OR, whether tumour cells remain at the edge of the removed tissue
brefsEurope.summary: Its SPCTRone device combines optical imaging and AI to analyse specimen margins during breast cancer surgery; it was tested at UMC Utrecht and the Academic Breast Centre Groningen. The round brings together the VGZ Voorop in Zorg fund, Future Tech Ventures, the NV NOM agency, business angels and the EU Just Transition Fund, to fund a multicentre study, a first device series and CE marking.

brefsEurope.title: Equasens enters exclusive talks to take a majority stake in Synapse Medicine, maker of MedGPT
brefsEurope.summary: Founded in 2017, the Bordeaux company holds 7 CE-marked class IIb medical devices, a HAS-approved drug database and the MedGPT AI assistant, deployed in dozens of hospitals including five university hospitals and available in ten European countries; its tools reach more than 400,000 healthcare professionals. Financial terms were not disclosed: a textbook trade exit for prescribing-support medical device software.

brefsEurope.title: BiBBInstruments wins a new US order for EndoDrill GI, its powered EUS biopsy tool
brefsEurope.summary: US distributor TaeWoong Medical USA ordered about SEK 1.2M ($118,000) worth, with delivery planned for Q1 2027, following SEK 1.75M of orders in September. Founded by a Lund University cancer researcher, the company bills EndoDrill GI as the first market-cleared (FDA 510(k) and CE mark) powered biopsy instrument for endoscopic ultrasound, a tool for better sampling of pancreatic tumours.

brefsEurope.title: Calla Lily Clinical Care wins a £700k Innovate UK grant to adapt its Callavid intravaginal device to probiotics
brefsEurope.summary: Awarded through the Growth Catalyst: Investor Partnerships programme (a £1M project with matched private investment), the grant funds the FLORA project: improving the transfer and retention of lactobacilli with its patented intravaginal delivery platform and building a lab model of bacterial colonisation, aiming at a first over-the-counter product.

brefsEurope.title: Amsterdam UMC, UvA and VU launch Amsterdam MedTech to speed innovations to patients
brefsEurope.summary: The initiative links clinicians, researchers and industry around imaging, AI and robotics applied to oncology and cardiovascular care, under the Dutch MedTech Growth Plan (Europe's strongest medtech ecosystem by 2035). First project: diagnosing and treating lung cancer in a single visit using advanced microscopy and AI — a future pipeline of spin-offs.

brefsIntl.title: DeepHealth wins 510(k) for Mammo Risk, which predicts 3-to-5-year breast cancer risk from a 3D mammogram
brefsIntl.summary: Clearance K262709, dated Nov 23: the AI, trained on 220,000 studies, estimates risk from tomosynthesis images alone, with no questionnaire or extra scan, and performed consistently across more than 65,000 mammograms from ten US sites. Its previous generation (two-year risk) is already CE-marked in Europe and validated by Karolinska Institutet researchers.

word.fr: Checking surgical margins during the operation
word.definition: Checking, during surgery and within minutes, that the tissue removed around a tumour is "clean" at its edges, so the surgeon can remove what remains right away instead of waiting days for the pathology report.

parts.label: Surgical specimen
parts.role: the removed tissue, whose surfaces (margins) are examined

parts.label: Imaging sensor
parts.role: OCT, confocal microscopy or optical imaging that sees the tissue's microstructure

parts.label: AI algorithm
parts.role: flags areas suspicious for tumour cells to the surgeon

how.t: As soon as the tumour is removed (for instance in breast-conserving surgery), the specimen is placed on the device in the OR, without lengthy histology preparation.
The system scans the margins at near-cellular resolution: wide-field OCT at Perimeter, fluorescence confocal microscopy at SamanTree, optical imaging at SPCTR.
AI highlights at-risk areas; the surgeon removes additional tissue during the same procedure, while pathology remains the reference for the final diagnosis.

word.why: About 20% of breast-conserving surgeries in the US lead to a repeat operation because a margin turns out to be involved after the fact: a human and economic cost these tools promise to eliminate. The category has just taken regulatory shape — FDA PMA for Perimeter's Claire in March 2026, 510(k) for SamanTree's Histolog Scanner in 2024 — and AI turns it into an OR product with strong recurring revenue (consumables, software). SPCTR's raise shows new European entrants coming in through optical imaging, natural targets for imaging and surgery majors.

startups.name: SPCTR
startups.use: Develops SPCTRone, optical imaging + AI that analyses margins intraoperatively in breast cancer; €2.8M seed in November 2026, CE marking in preparation

startups.name: SamanTree Medical
startups.use: Its Histolog Scanner (fluorescence confocal microscopy) is CE-marked and FDA 510(k)-cleared; the SHIELD study reported a 67% drop in reoperations; Series B extension led by Karista in 2026 for the US launch

startups.name: Perimeter Medical Imaging AI
startups.use: Claire (wide-field OCT + ImgAssist AI) became in March 2026 the first FDA-approved (PMA) AI imaging device for breast cancer margins, with 88.1% accuracy in the pivotal trial
